decisions.reason: The explicit stage recipe gathered the electric field without multiplying by c=Q/M. Linearity of deposition, the gauged Poisson solve, centered differentiation and gathering gives (Q/P) sum_r E_{epsilon,h}(X_p,X_r); the declared phase kernel requires c times that quantity. For general Q/M the procedure therefore contradicted its defining F. The repair explicitly returns (V_p,c(G_X E_h)_p) at each stage, with stage velocities and E_h=-D^0 phi_h.

F2 explicitly cites the supplier proof, rather than asserting that the supplier Statement contains the stronger coupling estimate. In thm-periodic-pic-mean-field-error-with-force-defect, step 1.1 proves duplicate initial atoms share one path, step 2.1 expresses the grid path as a continuum-kernel characteristic flow with residual at most delta_{epsilon,h}, and step 3.1 explicitly proves the transported cost bound for every prescribed pi_0 of cost D_0. The published Dobrushin supplier Statement and proof steps 1.1-2.1 provide exactly that bound under the assumed integrable path suprema. Splitting the finite atomic slices into label measures of mass 1/P, replacing their exact states by RK4 states, applying finite Cauchy-Schwarz, and taking the initial-cost infimum are valid. The contract quotes the weaker supplier Statement accurately; the explicitly cited intermediate proof supplies the stronger fact. No mathematical repair is needed.

reviews.reason: Reviewed the admissible smooth fixed-epsilon grid, equal charges Q/P and masses M/P, compatible deposition, exact gauged Fourier solve, centered field and shared gather weights. With the added c=Q/M multiplication and stage velocity V_p the stage recipe computes the displayed pair-kernel field exactly; the four coefficients match the classical RK4 tableau. Zero charge gives free streaming without a division by Q. This is a repair-time review by the repair author, not an independent review.

The supplier proof establishes the prescribed-coupling estimate used by F2 and step 1.2, including coincident initial atoms. Every label slice has mass 1/P and the slice sum reconstructs the transported coupling; substituting numerical states adds at most the stacked Euclidean error divided by sqrt(P). Infimizing D_0 yields delta_0 without choosing an optimal plan. Unit-source translation preserves derivative suprema and the joint shifted-product quadrature constant; multiplying the uniform field bound by |cQ| bounds the phase-kernel defect. The RK4 tube, exact initialization and retained partial-grid hypotheses match F3, including n=0 and P=1. No Statement, proof or contract change is needed.
